results.title: Big Boom AJ Takes ALS Ice Bucket Challenge, DREAM Wrestling Raises $7,181 For Rebel

The promotion, run by Truth Magnum of The Outrunners, hosted a benefit show in late July that raised $7,181.41 for the cause.
